description: Source code for managing and walking through reflog entries in a Git repository, including reading reflogs, selecting entries by time or index, and displaying reflog information.

classes.name: complete_reflogs
classes.description: Structure holding reflog references and items, including reference names and an array of reflog entries.

classes.name: commit_reflog
classes.description: Represents a specific reflog with a record number, selection type, and associated reflogs.

classes.name: reflog_walk_info
classes.description: Holds information for walking through reflog entries, including an array of commit_reflog pointers, and related metadata.

methods.name: read_one_reflog
methods.description: Callback to read a single reflog entry and store it in the reflogs array.

methods.name: free_complete_reflog
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a complete_reflogs structure.

methods.name: complete_reflogs_clear
methods.description: Clears reflog data in the context of string_list cleanup.

methods.name: read_complete_reflog
methods.description: Reads and constructs a complete reflog for a given reference.

methods.name: get_reflog_recno_by_time
methods.description: Finds the reflog record number closest to a given timestamp.

methods.name: init_reflog_walk
methods.description: Initializes a reflog walk info structure.

methods.name: reflog_walk_info_release
methods.description: Releases memory associated with a reflog walk info structure.

methods.name: add_reflog_for_walk
methods.description: Adds a reflog entry for a specific commit and reference name to the walk.

methods.name: get_reflog_selector
methods.description: Generates a string representing the reflog entry's reference and date.

methods.name: get_reflog_message
methods.description: Retrieves the message associated with a reflog entry.

methods.name: get_reflog_ident
methods.description: Returns the email identifier of the reflog entry.

methods.name: get_reflog_timestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the reflog entry.

methods.name: show_reflog_message
methods.description: Displays the reflog message, optionally in a one-line format.

methods.name: reflog_walk_empty
methods.description: Checks if the reflog walk info has no entries.

methods.name: next_reflog_commit
methods.description: Retrieves the next commit object from a reflog entry.

methods.name: log_timestamp
methods.description: Gets the timestamp of a reflog entry.

methods.name: next_reflog_entry
methods.description: Retrieves the next commit in order from multiple reflog sources.
